question: During the decomposition reaction of lead nitrate, the observed brown colour fumes are of which gas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitrogen dioxide gas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• During the thermal decomposition of lead nitrate (Pb(NO₃)₂), brown fumes are observed due to the formation of nitrogen dioxide gas (NO₂).
 
• The reaction can be represented as: 2Pb(NO₃)₂ (s) → 2PbO (s) + 4NO₂ (g) + O₂ (g).
 
• Nitrogen dioxide is a reddish-brown gas and is one of the several nitrogen oxides.
 
• This gas is a significant air pollutant and has a sharp, biting odor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lead Nitrate Decomposition**

 
 
• Lead nitrate decomposes upon heating to produce lead oxide (PbO), nitrogen dioxide (NO₂), and oxygen (O₂).
 
• This is an example of a thermal decomposition reaction, where a compound breaks down into simpler substances when heated.
 
 
 
• **Nitrogen Dioxide (NO₂)**
 
 
• Nitrogen dioxide is a toxic gas and a prominent air pollutant.
 
• It is primarily produced from combustion processes, including vehicle emissions and industrial activities.
 
• Prolonged exposure to high levels of NO₂ can cause respiratory problems and other health issues.
 
 
 
• **Thermal Decomposition**
 
 
• Thermal decomposition is a chemical reaction in which a compound breaks down into two or more products upon heating.
 
• It is an endothermic process, meaning it requires the absorption of heat.
 
 
 
• **Air Pollution**
 
 
• Air pollution refers to the presence of harmful substances in the atmosphere, including gases like nitrogen dioxide, sulfur dioxide, and particulate matter.
 
• It can have significant adverse effects on human health, the environment, and the climate.
